verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Asana serves an llms.txt at developers.asana.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), which tells agents to append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown. Cited doc URLs such as webhooks-guide.md and using-asanas-mcp-server.md show those markdown pages exist across the docs. missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or curated agent-specific guidance (the llms.txt header is generic), and independent community corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown
Webhooks allow an application to be notified of changes in Asana.
